svg.text: Separate VDI from the free VMware lab
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
A remote desktop in VMware teaches administration but is not Azure Virtual Desktop. AVD
includes host pools, application groups, workspaces, user entitlement and Azure session-host
This optional branch uses one personal Windows 11 Enterprise single-session host and one
assigned learner, not several always-on desktops or a multi-session fleet. Avoid managed AD DS,
VPN Gateway and FSLogix shared profile storage in this first Entra-joined personal-host
The free local baseline remains available if the licensed cloud design does not fit. Do not
relabel a server’s two administrative RDP sessions as a licensed user VDI service.
Check: You can describe which system is being built and why the optional branch costs more.
